alerts.area: Parts of Troms and northern Nordland
alerts.description: From monday morning until tuesday forenoon, heavy rainfall is expected, locally 50-80 mm in 24 hours in lower areas.
alerts.instruction: Flooding will occur: Clear drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.
